questions: What are the precise mechanisms and conditions that lead to the quenching of star formation in galaxies, particularly in different environments and at various cosmic epochs?
How do the properties and dynamics of the circumgalactic medium influence the accretion of gas onto galaxies and their subsequent star formation rates?
What is the role of active galactic nuclei (AGN) feedback in regulating star formation and galaxy evolution across different mass scales and cosmic times?
How do the observed scaling relations, such as the Tully-Fisher relation and the fundamental plane, evolve with redshift and what physical processes govern these changes?
What are the detailed processes behind the formation and evolution of ultra-faint dwarf galaxies, particularly in relation to reionization and their interactions with the Local Group?
